Wally Cup
Sep 10–13, 2026
Final
The Recap
Wally Cup Weekend

“Sixteen players. Three legendary Pocono courses. Four grueling rounds. From the historic grounds of Honesdale to the back-to-back battles at Skytop, all the way to the fairways of Paupack Hills — this weekend, our golfers didn’t just play a game. They covered twenty-two thousand, one hundred eighteen yards. That’s twelve and a half miles of fairways, roughs, and — for some of you — a few extra trips into the woods.

But when the dust settled, only one player could be crowned champion… Mohamed Walli!”
